questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The maximum safe speed for a residential area.
The maximum safe speed for an expressway exit.
The maximum safe speed for an expressway entrance.
The maximum safe speed for a work zone.

questions.correctAnswerText: The maximum safe speed for an expressway exit.
questions.explanation: This sign shows the maximum safe speed for exiting a highway. In this example, the safe speed is 30 mph.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Drive with caution and be ready to slow down.
Do not drive in this lane.
You must come to a complete stop and yield the right-of-way.
Slow down, be prepared to stop, and, if necessary, yield the right-of-way.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down, be prepared to stop, and, if necessary, yield the right-of-way.
questions.explanation: A triangular yield sign means you must slow down at the intersection. Be ready to stop. Let other vehicles, cyclists, or pedestrians pass safely before you go.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the road becomes slippery when it is wet.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead is closed to traffic.
The highway ahead is undergoing maintenance.

questions.correctAnswerText: The highway ahead is undergoing maintenance.
questions.explanation: Orange construction signs warn drivers about work zones and hazards ahead. This sign tells you a construction zone is coming. Slow down and drive carefully through the area.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot turn right at this location.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert you to upcoming hazards and road conditions. This sign warns you that cattle may cross the road ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road ahead has multiple turns and curves.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This regulation sign tells drivers in the left lane that they must turn left. All drivers must obey regulation signs.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Keep to the side indicated by the arrow.
You may drive in the left lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: Keep to the side indicated by the arrow.
questions.explanation: This "Keep right" sign tells you to drive on the right side of a traffic island, median, or barrier ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with yellow background and black markings. They alert you to hazards ahead. This sign warns you to drive carefully when the road is wet because it may be slippery and harder to control your vehicle.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You are about to enter a one-way street the wrong way.
Do not drive in this lane.
Traffic turning left on the green light must yield to oncoming traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Traffic turning left on the green light must yield to oncoming traffic.
questions.explanation: This sign tells drivers that when turning left on a green light, they must wait for oncoming traffic to pass first. Left-turning traffic does not have the right-of-way.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Turn right after making a complete stop.

questions.explanation: This is a regulatory sign that shows a law drivers must follow. You cannot turn right where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Fines double in a work zone.

questions.explanation: This warning sign (usually yellow with black markings) tells drivers that there is not much space above the road ahead. Tall vehicles may not fit.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead curves right. Slow down to the safe speed indicated.
Divided highway begins. Slow down to the safe speed indicated.
Merge. Slow down to the safe speed indicated.
Winding road ahead. Slow down to the safe speed indicated.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead curves right. Slow down to the safe speed indicated.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road curves to the right ahead. Reduce your speed to the number shown (in this case, 35 mph) to safely navigate the curve.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This warning sign alerts you that a four-way intersection is coming up ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This warning sign (usually yellow with black markings) notifies drivers that the road will curve. Be prepared to slow down and adjust your steering.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Circular signs indicate railroad crossings. This sign warns you that a railroad crossing is ahead. Watch for trains and listen for warning signals.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you a roundabout is coming. Slow down as you enter and let traffic already in the roundabout go first.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign indicates the road ahead is now divided. Stay to the right of the divider or median.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a school crossing is ahead. Be alert for students crossing the road and be ready to slow down or stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This is a warning sign. Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. This sign alerts you that buggies may be ahead on the road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This is a warning sign. Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. This sign tells you to be careful when the road is wet and slippery.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot turn right at this intersection. You must obey this sign.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that drivers from both directions may use the shared center lane to turn left only. Do not use this center lane to drive straight.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A community service group is picking up trash along the highway ahead.
Workers are on or very close to the road in the work zone ahead.
There is a pedestrian crosswalk ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Workers are on or very close to the road in the work zone ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that workers may be on or near the road ahead. Drive carefully through this area.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The exact speed at which you must travel to avoid a ticket.
The maximum safe driving speed under ideal road and weather conditions.
The maximum safe driving speed under all road conditions.

questions.correctAnswerText: The maximum safe driving speed under ideal road and weather conditions.
questions.explanation: A speed limit sign shows the highest legal speed for that road under good conditions. You should drive slower if the weather or road conditions are poor.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This is a warning sign. Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. This sign tells you a playground is nearby and you should watch for children on or near the road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that from this lane, you can either turn right or go straight at the intersection.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: There is a traffic signal ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: There is a traffic signal ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a traffic signal is coming up ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This orange construction sign warns you to be careful in work zones. This sign tells you that fines for traffic violations are higher in this work zone.
